name: What types of lighting are best for a laundry room?

mainEntity.name: What types of lighting are best for a laundry room?

acceptedAnswer.text: For laundry rooms, bright, uniform, and energy-efficient lighting is recommended. LED recessed lighting or flush-mount fixtures provide general ambient light without taking up much space. Task lighting, such as under-cabinet strips above a folding counter, is beneficial for detailed work. Consider fixtures with a color temperature around 4000K-5000K (cool white) to accurately see fabric colors and stains. Moisture-resistant fixtures are also important if your laundry room has high humidity.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED recessed lights or flush mounts offer general illumination. Task lighting above counters helps with detailed work. Opt for cool white, moisture-resistant fixtures.
